architecture_decisions: The architecture decision is to maintain the exact timestamp metadata for the server-owned Parallax actor identity and timestamp metadata.
work_items: The work item is to ensure that the provider read-back `date` is chronology metadata and exists, is a non-empty string, and parse as an offset-aware ISO-8601/RFC3339 instant.
validations: The validation is to ensure that the provider normalization or substitution of the timestamp does not invalidate the baseline if every authority-bearing invariant and timestamp are met.

AC-01: validate protected requirement — `CURRENT-STATE.md` records exact `.37` merge, post-merge gates, READY deployment, preflights, health/readiness and frozen W9-S1 replay without claiming successful publication.
AC-02: validate protected requirement — Tests prove author and committer must both contain exact Parallax actor name and email. Any mismatch fails baseline verification.
AC-03: validate protected requirement — Tests prove two different valid offset-aware provider timestamps are accepted without requiring equality to `_ACTOR["date"]`.
AC-04: validate protected requirement — Tests reject missing, empty, non-string, invalid or timezone-naive actor/committer date values.
AC-05: validate protected requirement — Existing and focused regressions prove message, parent, tree, marker, provenance and default-ref mismatch behavior is unchanged.
AC-06: validate protected requirement — The production-shaped two-commit baseline with provider timestamps replays using GET-only verification and returns the existing baseline without mutation.
AC-07: validate protected requirement — The P2-V0.23.37 Contents-root plus Git Data empty-tree/commit/non-force-ref sequence remains unchanged and green.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Diff review proves no provider, permission, credential, repository scope, arbitrary actor, arbitrary Git mutation, force-ref, lifecycle, REVIEW or production authority expansion.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Spec validation, authentic DSPy SpecCritic/SpecCompiler, strict DSPy plan validation, focused/full applicable tests, Bounded Autonomy, Workstream Spec Validation and P2 CI pass on exact reviewed heads.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Exact merged source reaches production READY; build preflights pass; canonical `/health` and `/ready` return 200; exact-deployment runtime error scan is clean before acceptance replay.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — The same W9-S1 Engineering Run at REVIEW is retried. Exact production evidence proves `GREENFIELD_BASELINE_MISMATCH`, `PROVIDER_CONFLICT` and `TARGET_DISCOVERY_UNBOUNDED` do not recur. Successful Git branch/accepted-lineage commit/PR/Preview publication may satisfy the benchmark up to unchanged human REVIEW; any later independent blocker is recorded separately.
risks: The risk is that the exact cleanup commit has the fixed cleanup message, canonical empty tree, and one bootstrap parent, which may cause issues if the baseline is not properly updated.
